title: Add prebuilt binaries for ppc64le and s390x
author: eelgaev
summary: Cross-compiles ppc64le and s390x Linux GNU binaries in release CI and adds them to build-npm.js. Node.js core's CI (doc tooling via Vite) fails on these platforms because lightningcss has no binary, so there is concrete demand; the open question is whether to take on untestable, partly big-endian targets.
evidence: No maintainer review on this PR. On #1163, ovflowd (Node.js) 2026-10-19 links failing node-test-commit-plinux/linuxone jobs (`Cannot find module '../lightningcss.linux-ppc64-gnu.node'` / s390x) and says Node must support these platforms; sapphi-red (member) 2026-10-20: no npm access, and unsure Devon wants prebuilt binaries, "especially for s390x (which is big endian)". IronBlood reported an occasional segfault at process exit running the JS tests on ppc64 (2026-10-20). devongovett declined the narrower #1294 on 2026-07-20 for usage/testability reasons.
decision: Will Lightning CSS publish ppc64le and s390x Linux prebuilts (untested in CI, s390x big-endian) to unblock Node.js core's CI, or should those users rely on the WASM build / building from source?
